```text
backdown serve [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

`--port <PORT>`
: Port on 127.0.0.1. Default: `8787`.

`--no-open`
: Don't open a browser, just print the link.

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

The browser listens on 127.0.0.1 only and prints a private link with a one-time token. It only reads: copying, wiping, rescues and rescans need the daemon (`backdown service install`, then `backdown open`).

## Examples

```sh
backdown serve
# another port, and just print the link
backdown serve --port 8788 --no-open
```
